verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe step.sleep/waitForEvent suspending execution while holding zero resources, resuming from checkpoint after arbitrarily long waits (e.g., 'suspends entirely, holding zero resources, and resumes when the approval arrives'), and this is corroborated by community usage reports of reliable long-running background jobs. missing for 10: independent benchmark/hands-on confirmation of multi-month sleeps specifically (only human-in-the-loop/hour-scale examples shown).
